verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents a stealth mode with anti-detection techniques for bypassing bot protection, plus an 'Ultra Stealth Mode' for extra evasion. It also documents session proxy routing for geo-restricted content, IP rotation and distributing requests across locations. One community user reported being instantly blocked by Cloudflare, but it is unclear whether stealth or proxies were enabled, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of residential proxies, detail on fingerprint configuration or geo-targeting options, independent hands-on corroboration that stealth evades detection.
